business_scope.primary_industry_name: Generative Artificial Intelligence and LLM Inference APIs

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: US-Oman Free Trade Agreement (in force 1 January 2009)
Oman-People's Republic of China Bilateral Investment Treaty (1995)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Commercial Companies Law, Royal Decree 18/2019 (as consolidated by Royal Decree 75/2023), and its Executive Regulations (MOCIIP Ministerial Decision 209/2020), mandating beneficial-owner disclosure in the commercial register; Law on Combating Money Laundering and Combating the Financing of Terrorism, Royal Decree 30/2016 (as amended); Central Bank of Oman AML/CFT Regulations (2017, as updated), extending customer due diligence and UBO identification obligations to designated non-financial businesses and professions; 100% foreign ownership permitted for non-restricted activities under the Commercial Companies Law.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the sole shareholder's passport (notarized in country of origin)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public / competent authority in the shareholder's jurisdiction of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Oman is a contracting party to the 1961 Apostille Convention, effective 30 January 2018); Omani Embassy consular legalization required for non-member jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney appointing the Omani subscriber / registered agent for incorporation filings
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the shareholder's jurisdiction or Omani consular post
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Omani consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Resolution of corporate shareholder (board or shareholders' resolution) authorizing incorporation of the Omani Single Person Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate secretary / notary public in the jurisdiction of incorporation of the parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Omani consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or certificate of incumbency (required where shareholder is a corporate entity)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company/commercial registry in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Omani consular legalization

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening under Oman's AML/CFT Law (Royal Decree 30/2016) of all UBOs, authorized signatories, and shareholders of the SPC against: (i) UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list; (ii) OFAC SDN and other OFAC lists; (iii) EU and UK OFSI consolidated lists; (iv) CBO domestic sanctions and terrorist designations; (v) PEP databases with enhanced due diligence in line with FATF Recommendation 12, including family members and close associates; (vi) adverse media, insolvency, and regulatory disqualification registers. Any confirmed hit triggers source-of-wealth/source-of-funds verification, re-piercing of the beneficial ownership chain, and, if unresolved, refusal of the engagement. The planned payment rail of cryptocurrency USDC is separately flagged for a VASP/stablecoin AML assessment under Central Bank of Oman licensing expectations before operational go-live.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Invest Easy (https://investeasy.gov.om) — the unified commercial registration single window of the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MOCIIP).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The company's commercial name must be registered first in Arabic script; a Latin/English transliteration may be added as a secondary trade name. The legal-form suffix 'Single Person Company (SPC)' must follow the trade name. The Arabic name governs for legal identification, and phonetically identical or confusingly similar names to existing registrants are refused regardless of script.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: "Bank", "Finance", "Insurance", "Reinsurance", "Investment Fund" and financial tokens (require prior licensing or no-objection from the Central Bank of Oman or the Financial Services Authority)
"Oman", "Omani", "Sultanate" and national-symbol tokens (require explicit ministerial authorization under the name-clearance rules)
"Royal", "Ruler", "Armed Forces", "Police", "State" and other sovereign or military-indicative tokens (generally prohibited)
"Islamic", "Quran", "Fatwa" and Allah-derived religious tokens (prohibited on public-order and morality grounds)
"National", "Government", "Public Authority" and similar institutional tokens (refused absent statutory licence)
"International", "Global", "Group" and scale-implying tokens (may be refused unless cross-border operations and capitalization structure are substantiated)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation may be extended once for a further 30 days upon payment of the renewal fee before expiry; otherwise the reservation lapses and must be refiled. Rejection notifications are issued electronically via Invest Easy with the stated refusal ground. Step 1: re-file a modified name or attach written justification, trademark, and prior-use evidence within the validity window. Step 2: file a 30-day administrative grievance to the Director General of Commercial Registration (MOCIIP) via the portal, quoting the rejection code. Step 3: if the grievance is denied, submit a formal administrative complaint to the Minister of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion within 30 days of the denial notification. Step 4: file a final appeal before the competent Omani Administrative Court within 60 days of the ministerial determination.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A purely virtual or domiciliation-only address is not accepted as the statutory registered office of an Omani Single Person Company. A physical serviced office or licensed co-working desk inside an operating business center is permissible for the AI/IT software services license, evidenced by a lease agreement submitted with the commercial registration application. Municipal signage and premises-access requirements apply, and the registered address must be operational and attended during business hours.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate; approximately 10-15% probability of an unannounced on-site inspection in any 12-month cycle by Municipal licensing inspectors or MOCIIP commercial-registry officers at the registered office. Inspection triggers include address inconsistency, employee-ratio mismatch versus the licensed activity category, and AML/CFT flagged transactions. The registered premises must maintain the company signboard and a valid tenancy contract.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Annual licensed serviced physical office / registered address package (business center)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Commercial Companies Law of the Sultanate of Oman, Royal Decree 18/2019, as amended: Articles 1-12 (incorporation general provisions), Article 89 (Single Person Company), Articles 91-119 (Limited Liability Company governance); implementing Executive Regulations issued by Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion, Ministerial Decision 214/2020.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) - Companies Registration Directorate, Muscat, Sultanate of Oman.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarized Articles of Association (Constitution of the Single Person Company) filed electronically through the Invest Easy portal; issuance of the Commercial Registration (CR) certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is imposed on a Single Person Company under Royal Decree 18/2019; the share capital is fixed in the Articles of Association and must be fully subscribed and fully paid at the time of incorporation, with a bank certificate confirming the deposit of the capital in the company's bank account to be submitted before issuance of the Commercial Registration certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: This First Board Resolution of [Company Name] LLC (Single Person Company), duly convened in Muscat, Oman on [DATE], resolves unanimously: 1. The Sole Shareholder's subscription to the entire share capital in the Articles of Association is approved; the consideration shall be deposited into the company's bank account, evidenced by a bank certificate before issuance of the Commercial Registration certificate. 2. The registered office is fixed at [Address], Wilayat of Muscat, Muscat Governorate, and Management is authorized to execute the lease and municipal registrations. 3. The following officers are appointed: [Name], Chief Executive Officer; [Name], Chief Financial Officer; [Name], Company Secretary, with full delegated authority for banking, administration, and license filings. Certified by the Chairman on [DATE].

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log into Invest Easy, create a user profile for the foreign founder, submit three proposed Arabic trade names in priority order with the English transliteration corresponding to the intended corporate style of the Single Person Company. The registry will screen the proposed names against registered marks and restricted expressions in compliance with the Commercial Registry Regulation.
required_dossiers: Three proposed Arabic company names in priority order
Passport copy of the sole foreign shareholder
Proof of any registered foreign trade name for the same brand
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the preferred name is rejected for similarity or prohibited expression, file a corrected name application through the same Invest Easy case within 10 working days; no fee is forfeited if the correction is filed within the statutory appeal window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Authentication and Legalization of Foreign Founder Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Sultanate of Oman - Authentication and Documentation Directorate; notary public authorized by the Ministry of Justice.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Authenticate the foreign shareholder's passport, power of attorney, and home-country corporate registry extracts at the Oman Embassy or a competent consular authority in the founder's jurisdiction, then attest the documents at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Muscat. Submit the authenticated set to the notary for certification of the founder's capacity to execute the Articles of Association.
required_dossiers: Apostilled or consular-attested passport and identity documents
Original power of attorney appointing the onshore signing agent
Certificate of good standing or equivalent registry extract from the founder's home country
Bank reference letter for the founding shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: In case of rejection, re-attest the deficient document in the country of issuance and re-submit to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs; the authenticated package is re-provided to the notary with a formal covering letter addressing the noted deficiency.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public Office at MoCIIP (Ministry of Justice notarization service), Muscat.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Arabic-language Articles of Association in the standard Single Person Company format, including the object clause restricted to ISIC 6201 computer programming and AI platform activities, capital clause, and governance provisions. The sole shareholder or its legal representative appears before the notary for signature; the notary records the minutes and issues the notarized instrument for registration.
required_dossiers: Draft Articles of Association in Arabic (Single Person Company standard template)
Name reservation approval slip from Invest Easy
Notarized and legalized passport or corporate documents of the sole shareholder
Power of attorney for the signing representative
Detailed object clause listing generative AI, LLM API, and software services
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: When the notary raises a clause-level objection, the company executes a supplementary deed of amendment before the same notary and re-files; a re-notarization appointment is typically available within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP - Companies Registration Directorate, Invest Easy portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the incorporation application on Invest Easy attaching the notarized Articles of Association, bank certificate of the deposited share capital, municipal pre-approval of the leased office address, and the authenticated founder documents. Pay the prescribed OMR fees online. Upon scrutiny, the registrar endorses the Articles and issues the Commercial Registration certificate bearing the company's CR number, commercial name, and ISIC 6201 classification.
required_dossiers: Notarized Articles of Association
Bank certificate confirming payment of the subscribed share capital
Certified copy of the registered office lease contract
Authenticated passport and legalization documents of the founder
Completed CR application form on Invest Easy
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, respond electronically through Invest Easy within 15 working days and provide the requested amendments; if registration is refused, the applicant may file an administrative appeal to the under-secretary of MoCIIP within 60 days of the refusal notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration with the Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI), Muscat branch.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the Commercial Registration certificate and notarized Articles of Association at the OCCI service counter or online portal. OCCI verifies the company particulars and imposes the annual membership subscription based on the company's capital and economic activity. The membership certificate is issued and is a precondition for trade licenses, import permits, and customs facilitation.
required_dossiers: Commercial Registration certificate
Notarized Articles of Association
Lease contract of the registered office
Passport copy of the authorized manager
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If membership is withheld for unpaid prescribed fees, settle the assessed subscription and re-submit the application; any classification mismatch is corrected by submitting the CR certificate evidencing ISIC 6201.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Operating License and Civil Defense Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Muscat Municipality - Business Licensing Department; Civil Defense and Ambulance Authority (CDAA); Ministry of Transport, Communications and Information Technology for ICT activity classification.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply to Muscat Municipality for the commercial operating license for information technology activities, attaching the CR certificate, OCCI membership, lease proof, and floor plan. In parallel, obtain the Civil Defense Fire Safety Certificate after physical inspection of the office premises, covering emergency exits, fire extinguishers, and IT server room safety. The completed file is referred to the municipality for final issuance of the physically anchored operating license, including the IT activity endorsement under ISIC 6201.
required_dossiers: Commercial Registration certificate
OCCI membership certificate
Registered lease contract and landlord No Objection Certificate
Floor plan and office layout of the registered premises
Civil Defense Fire Safety Certificate
Individual Identification Number of the authorized manager
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the civil defense inspection reports deficiencies, execute the safety rectification works within 20 working days and request a re-inspection through the CDAA e-services; if the municipality rejects the operating license, appeal to the Muscat Municipality licensing committee within 30 days after submitting rectification evidence.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Muscat Municipality (primary locality licensing authority) in coordination with the Ministry of Transport, Communications and Information Technology (MTCIT) for ICT sector classification; no separate industrial manufacturing permit is applicable as the activity is a non-industrial, cloud-based software service.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Municipal Commercial Operating License - Information Technology Activity (ISIC 6201, Generative AI and LLM API Services), endorsed as a technical service provider registration under MTCIT's electronic services classification.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environment Authority of the Sultanate of Oman (successor to the Ministry of Environment and Climate Affairs), Environmental Permits Department.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from a Full EIA Report; Category 'Registration' only for low-impact office and information technology activities under the Environmental Permit Regulations (Royal Decree 114/2001, as amended), because the operation involves no manufacturing, no discharge of process effluent, and no substantial land disturbance.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero process wastewater and zero point-source air emissions from the API platform operation; sanitary wastewater must comply with municipal sewer discharge standards (Oman Standard MOS 8:2006) when discharging to the Muscat wastewater network; electronic waste from servers and IT hardware must be disposed through licensed e-waste recyclers under Royal Decree 46/2014; no VOC emissions or toxic fugitive releases arise from the software activity; if an emergency backup diesel generator is installed, it must meet the ambient air quality limits of the Environment Authority for nitrogen oxides and particulate matter, with fuel storage below the hazardous substances notification threshold.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Civil Defense and Ambulance Authority (CDAA) after inspection of the registered office, covering fire extinguishers, smoke detection, emergency egress, and electrical load safety for IT equipment; structural load inspection and building safety clearance by Muscat Municipality confirming the premises are fit for office use; occupational safety clearance under the Labor Law (Royal Decree 35/2003) confirming a non-hazardous workplace with first-aid provisions and sufficient ventilation for IT server rooms; no industrial zoning clearance is required given the office-based ISIC 6201 classification.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA), Sultanate of Oman — online taxpayer portal: https://taxoman.om. Legal basis: Income Tax Law (Royal Decree No. 28/2009, as amended by Royal Decree No. 24/2022), VAT Law (Sultani Decree No. 121/2020) and VAT Executive Regulations (Royal Decree No. 53/2021). Customs is administered by Oman Customs (Directorate General of Customs) through the 'Bayan' national single window.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign-founded SPC procedure: (1) register the Single Person Company with the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MOCIIP) and obtain the Commercial Registration (CR) certificate; (2) notarise the SPC Articles of Association and register the resident manager; (3) apply online at taxoman.om for the unified Tax Identification Number (TIN) by uploading the CR, certified memorandum, manager/shareholder passports or company CR, registered-office lease, local bank account confirmation and, where relevant, the shareholder's foreign tax-residency certificate; (4) open the VAT account through the same portal once the registration threshold applies (non-resident persons supplying digital services are registrable regardless of threshold); (5) receive the OTA tax registration certificate and unique VAT/TIN number. OTA processing typically takes 5–15 business days from complete submission.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — the OM_SPC is a distinct juridical and taxable person resident in Oman; profits are taxed at the corporate level and are not passed through to the foreign shareholder. The company is subject to income tax on worldwide income arising to it; the standard CIT rate is 15% for tax years beginning from 2023, with the first OMR 100,000 of taxable income of a qualifying Riyada-registered SME effectively taxed at 0%. Distributions of profits to the shareholder are not re-taxed at shareholder level; capital gains form part of ordinary taxable income; no payroll, net-worth or municipal taxes apply.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Oman does not operate a US-style check-the-box election, and no hybrid-mismatch election exists under domestic law. Available statutory options: (i) voluntary VAT registration at OMR 19,250; (ii) VAT group election for related persons; (iii) input-VAT allocation method for mixed-use supplies; (iv) application to the OTA for advance rulings or advance pricing agreements on cross-border digital/API service pricing; (v) small-enterprise CIT treatment (0% on the first OMR 100,000 of taxable income) upon certification under Riyada SME criteria; (vi) income-tax loss carry-forward of five years. None of these mechanisms converts the SPC into a pass-through vehicle.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) — GCC Common VAT regime enacted by Sultani Decree No. 121/2020 and implemented under Royal Decree No. 53/2021; VAT applies to supplies of goods and services made in Oman (including digital, software and AI/LLM API platform services), and to imports into Oman.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Mandatory registration: OMR 38,500 of taxable supplies in any consecutive 12-month period; voluntary registration: OMR 19,250. A non-resident making taxable digital AI/API supplies to Omani customers has no threshold suppression and must register from the commencement of the supply activity; a resident SPC must apply within 30 days after the end of the month in which the threshold is exceeded.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Oman does not yet mandate real-time fiscal clearance through API stamping or digital stamping for all taxpayers. Currently in force: issuance of sequential statutory Tax Invoices and Simplified Tax Invoices with all prescribed content; electronic filing of periodic VAT returns and payments via the OTA portal; retention of invoice and transaction records in Arabic or English for at least five years; and reverse-charge self-accounting on imported B2B services such as overseas cloud, model-hosting and data-centre services. The OTA has announced a phased national e-invoicing and real-time clearance roadmap; the SPC should maintain machine-readable invoice files and a full audit trail now to ease future migration.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating (0%) applies to: (i) exported goods consigned outside the GCC where export is proven by customs documentation and occurs within the statutory period; (ii) exported services supplied to a customer established outside the GCC (or to a GCC-resident non-taxable person where the service is effectively used and enjoyed outside the GCC), including AI/LLM API inference, hosted model access, software-as-a-service and licensing, provided the customer-location place-of-supply rule is met; and (iii) international transport and related services. For the AI API platform, zero-rating requires non-resident customers, foreign payment flows, and no effective use or enjoyment of the service inside Oman.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Bayan single-window export entry with customs stamp and OTA interface)
Export commercial invoice (serialised; stating supplier TIN, zero-rated treatment and export reference)
Bill of Lading, Airway Bill, CMR or equivalent transport document evidencing physical departure from Oman
Customs port or airport certificate evidencing exit of the goods from Omani customs territory
Service contract, SOW or API subscriber agreement identifying the non-resident customer and territorial scope
Inward Remittance Certificate (IRC), SWIFT receipts or accepted crypto-to-fiat conversion records evidencing receipt of export proceeds
Foreign customer's VAT registration number or tax-residence certificate supporting zero-rating of exported services
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: OTA audit processes match zero-rated export claims against customs declarations, port movement logs and domestic bank receipts; supporting documentation must be retained for the statutory periods (five years under VAT rules, and the longer books-and-records period under the Income Tax Law). Penalties: administrative fines generally in the range of OMR 250–10,000 per violation under the VAT Law and Executive Regulations; late payment charge of 5% per month on unpaid tax (capped); clawback of export refunds obtained without entitlement, with reassessment and interest; deregistration and publication as a defaulting taxpayer; and criminal fines with imprisonment of up to three years for fraudulent export and refund schemes. The Income Tax Law separately penalises mischaracterised or non-arm's-length export revenue through CIT reassessment and related penalties.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Oman (CBO), Muscat — the sole monetary authority, foreign-exchange supervisor, and payments-system overseer in the Sultanate of Oman, acting under the Banking Law (Royal Decree 114/2000 as amended), the Foreign Investment Capital Law (Royal Decree 50/2019), and the Commercial Companies Law (Royal Decree 18/2019 as amended). The CBO operates the national real-time gross settlement system (MIR) and prescribes the balance-of-payments statistical reporting framework that all licensed banks apply to cross-border remittances.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Omani Rial (OMR) is fixed at 1 OMR = 2.6008 USD and is fully convertible for current-account transactions, consistent with Oman's IMF Article VIII obligations. Capital-account flows are liberal: a 100% foreign-owned Single Person Company (SPC) may receive equity injections, draw intercompany loans, and remit dividends overseas without CBO prior approval, provided the paying bank obtains the underlying corporate documentation. Profit-repatriation hurdles are limited to documentary form (valid commercial registration, UBO declaration, banking mandate, articles of association, and proof of tax filing status where the SPC exceeds the Oman Tax Authority filing threshold). There is no repatriation quota, no exchange stabilization levy, and no differential conversion rate for the AI/LLM API services export stream.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Oman imposes no mandatory surrender of export proceeds and no statutory minimum conversion ratio. The Omani SPC may retain its Stripe/USDC-origin export earnings in USD or any convertible foreign currency in its own account at a CBO-licensed bank; conversion to OMR is optional and commercial. Binding conditions are: (i) contemporaneous documentation of the underlying AI/LLM API export invoices; (ii) credit of proceeds to an account in the SPC's name at a licensed Omani bank; and (iii) inclusion of large-value cross-border receipts in the CBO balance-of-payments statistical return. No surrender timeline applies to ISIC 6201 service export receipts.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (multi-currency OMR/USD; no statutory capital escrow required for an SPC)
Operational Account (USD concentration cell and OMR disbursement sub-ledger)
Operational Account (HSBCnet global clearing, multi-currency USD/EUR/GBP)
Operational Account (e-commerce settlement and USD/OMR treasury sweeps)
Operational Account (payroll clearing and future trade-finance LC line for GPU/hardware procurement)
Operational Account (OMR liquidity and public-sector collections)
Operational Account (digital account opening and API-enabled transaction reporting)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility as a primary treasury rail. Offshore digital EMIs (Wise Business, Airwallex, Currencycloud, Dukascopy) are not CBO-licensed deposit-taking institutions and do not settle OMR through CBO's MIR RTGS. Under the Omani Banking Law no unlicensed entity may carry on banking or payment-service business in Oman, so an onshore licensed bank must remain the domicile of the SPC's liquidity. An offshore EMI may be used only as a supplementary collection conduit for a Stripe merchant account held in a supported jurisdiction, provided the EMI sweeps net proceeds via SWIFT/SEPA into the Tier-1 Omani bank's USD concentration account. The SPC must never maintain its statutory share capital or tax settlement balances at an EMI.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote account opening is not statutorily prohibited, but all Tier-1 Omani banks de facto require one in-person signing ceremony at a Muscat branch. The SPC's legally appointed director/manager — or a resident individual holding a notarized power of attorney — must appear physically with the original Commercial Registration (CR), the SPC's foundational deed, valid passports, UBO disclosure forms, and the Oman Tax Authority registration certificate. Recommended protocol: conduct a single Muscat onboarding week and schedule separate meetings at two or three banks to avoid dependency on one compliance outcome.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident structure without local substance: 100% foreign UBO and no physical Oman footprint, creating shell-company or booking-shop risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SPC statutory registration file and the shareholder resolution appointing a resident manager; leased registered-office agreement and mainland employment contracts for operational staff; Oman Corporate Income Tax registration certificate and tax-return filing receipts; an organizational chart demonstrating real IT operations, IP ownership, billing, and service-desk substance in Oman; bank-mandate form naming the local director/manager with notarized power of attorney; SPC Commercial Registration precisely matching the ISIC 6201 scope; a confirmation letter that no director or UBO is listed on OFAC, EU, or UN sanctions lists.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Equity injection: the foreign parent sends a SWIFT MT103 credit to the SPC's USD operational account at the nominated Omani bank with the purpose narrative 'Share Capital Subscription — [CR No.]', which the bank maps to CBO's balance-of-payments statistical classification of direct-investment equity. Intercompany loan drawdown: SWIFT MT103 (or MT202 for nostro-level credits) with the narrative 'Intercompany Loan — [Loan Agreement Date]', accompanied by the executed facility agreement and the SPC board resolution. The collecting bank verifies the CR, the account mandate, UBO disclosure, and an expected-value notification for amounts exceeding the CBO statistical reporting threshold. Operating-liquidity receipts use the same inbound rail: Stripe payouts are swept by SWIFT/SEPA from Stripe's banking partners or an approved Merchant-of-Record (Paddle or FastSpring) directly into the USD concentration account; USDC proceeds are converted through a CMA/CBO-licensed VASP or licensed Omani bank OTC desk and swept within 48 hours to the same USD account.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rail for trade and operating disbursements: SWIFT MT103 customer credits executed under the bank's online approval matrix for cloud compute, GPU hosting, LLM API vendor fees, licensing payments, and intercompany settlements; each debit is evidenced by a vendor invoice and the SPC board's payment instruction. Documentary collection and irrevocable Commercial Letters of Credit (UCP600) are available and recommended for hardware procurement (GPU servers, storage arrays) requiring shipping and customs documents. Domestic OMR disbursements — payroll, rent, statutory social-protection contributions, VAT, and corporate tax installments — clear through CBO's MIR RTGS and the national salary-file channel. Treasury control measures: cumulative monthly payment caps per vendor, dual approval by the director/manager, and a standing prohibition on outbound wires referencing crypto-wallet addresses.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable OMR/USD outright forwards and spot-deferred forwards with a licensed Omani bank, tenor up to 12 months, supported by documented trade or balance-sheet exposure and no speculative positioning.
FX swaps (spot/forward rollovers and tom-next) that fund OMR working-capital requirements while preserving USD liability alignment.
Cross-currency spot conversions (USD, EUR, GBP, OMR) executed at the bank's dealing desk for invoice settlement, intercompany netting, and vendor payments.
Plain-vanilla FX options on OMR/USD permitted on a documented exposure basis; not recommended for the SPC given the fixed 2.6008 USD peg.
The OMR has no active non-deliverable forward (NDF) market; eligible hedging must be executed onshore as deliverable contracts.
Interest-rate or cross-currency swaps on OMR/USD are permissible for term-debt risk management but require execution solely through the onshore bank's treasury division.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual commercial registration renewal (licence renewal) for Single Person Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) – Commercial Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the expiry date of the current commercial registration; renewal available within 30 days prior to expiry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal incurs OMR 20 per month (approx. USD 52); continued non-renewal results in administrative strike-off and loss of legal standing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (including audited financial statements if threshold met)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months after the end of the calendar tax year; extension must be pre-approved and does not stop interest
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty starts at OMR 100 (approx. USD 260); further fines and interest on unpaid tax up to 10% per annum; prolonged default may lead to tax enforcement and licence suspension.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO confirmation and beneficial ownership declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: MoCIIP – Commercial Registry (Central Beneficial Ownership Register)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within 30 days after the commercial registration anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty for non-confirmation up to OMR 500 (approx. USD 1,300); failure to register UBO is an AML/CTF violation with director liability.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements filing (filed with tax return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Deadlines identical to the corporate income tax return; no separate filing to the registrar
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Same as income tax return; unaudited submission when audit is required attracts rejection and OMR 100 penalty.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory for all SPCs unless exempted as a small business under MoCIIP; statutory audit required under the new Corporate Tax Law and old Income Tax Law for companies with gross revenue exceeding OMR 50,000 or total assets exceeding OMR 100,000.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted by Oman; entities may use local GAAP if exempted.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Register of beneficial owners must be maintained at the registered office and an annual confirmation filed with MoCIIP within 30 days of the CR anniversary; UBO changes must be reported within 14 days.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 15% on taxable income exceeding OMR 30,000; 3% on the first OMR 30,000 of taxable income (Income Tax Law, Royal Decree 28/2009 as amended by Royal Decree 9/2017).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general national CIT holiday outside designated free zones. Free-zone entities (Sohar, Salalah, Duqm) may qualify for 10-15 year CIT exemptions on qualifying activities. A discretionary exemption of up to 5 years may be granted under Article 12 to projects serving national economic development. Wholly Omani-owned SMEs with gross revenue not exceeding OMR 100,000 are fully exempt from the 3% band. A foreign-owned Single Person Company operating an AI/LLM API platform outside a free zone is normally subject to the standard 3%/15% brackets.
